description_en: Binds a number to a business instance
name: CreateInstanceBindNumber

parameters.help_en:
The number to bind (required).

> For the list of numbers, see the Number parameter returned by the ListAllTenantBindNumberBinding API
parameters.help_zh:
绑定的号码（必填）

> 号码列表参考ListAllTenantBindNumberBinding接口的返回参数Number
parameters.name: number

parameters.help_en:
List of outbound calling instance IDs.

> Modifying this parameter overwrites previous parameters. Setting this parameter to empty clears the number binding list
parameters.help_zh:
智能外呼实例ID列表

> 修改该参数值会将覆盖之前参数，该参数置为空时表示将号码绑定列表置空
parameters.name: instance_list
